_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own oracle registration (ticket 26/08/23/END-TO-END-TESTING-REFACTOR wave 7). The `lopdf` package itself is already approved and linked by the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json manifest (id `lopdf`, capabilities `pdf-edit`/`pdf-parse`) -- this entry is a SEPARATE id because the mutation vocabulary it certifies (`pdf-1-4-mutate`, PdfMutation's own two variants: NoMutation/SetSnapshot over the 1.4 subset's PageDoc{width,height,text} snapshot) is not the same capability as the 1.7 subset's own richer `pdf-1-7-mutate` vocabulary. Reusing the shared `lopdf` id would fail the contract with oracle-capability-mismatch, per the wave 7 fleet brief.

oracles.rationale: The same PDF document-manipulation library already approved for pdf-edit/pdf-parse, surveyed here for a third capability: reading and independently constructing the single-page documents this subset's thin PdfSnapshot{width,height,text} model actually claims to round-trip. Serves as both the independent reader (page 1's real MediaBox and first shown text, read through lopdf's own content-stream decoder rather than this subset's byte-search decode_pdf) and the independent writer (a fresh lopdf::Document built object-by-object, never by delegating to this repository's own encode_pdf).
